intro.p: A greeting that doesn't lie. Instead of "another year behind" — "here's how much is left". We'll calculate your estimated death date using WHO data and create a personalised card with a timer. Send it to someone who values honesty.

preview.note: The death date in the preview is approximate. The exact date is calculated on the server using WHO data.

card.notFound: Card not found or has expired.

message.early: Most of the journey is still ahead. The perfect time to start thinking about what matters.
message.quarter: A quarter of your allotted time is officially behind you. A great excuse to drink something nice.
message.half: More than half of your allotted time is officially gone. The final act is not far off.
message.late: The final act. Spending time well is the only way to beat it.

notFound.title: Page is dead
notFound.message1: It existed once, but time took its toll.
notFound.message2: Or maybe it never existed at all — who knows.
